baselineReason: Phase 12 recorded Home at 94982 bytes; the shipped Phase 13/14 surfaces pushed it to 98719, and the shared listing browser then added its own chunk. Re-measured after splitting ListingBrowser and ListingGallery out of the shell chunk, so Detail and the legal/account pages no longer download feed code.
measurementMethod: production build (nuxt build) -> static .output/public scripts referenced by the SSR document of each route -> gzip level 9. Same assets and the same gzip level the CI capture script measures; CI re-measures over HTTP and remains authoritative.

detail.note: Measured from the build's page->chunk manifest (precomputed.mjs) rather than an HTTP load: the local sandbox has no MariaDB, so the fixture listing used by CI's HTTP capture does not exist here. Same assets, same gzip level; CI re-measures over HTTP and stays authoritative.
